name: Summer Art Intensive
org: The Cooper Union School of Art
what_you_do: A four-week art program on the Cooper Union campus. You take a studio course such as drawing, painting or animation. Pro artists and Cooper Union student helpers guide you. You build a portfolio.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 18. You are a rising sophomore to rising senior or the same level.
pay_detail: 2027 tuition is $4,350 to $4,500 depending on the course, including a $270 non-refundable registration fee, art materials and field trips. The Gural Merit Scholarship for NYC Public School Students covers full tuition.
duration: Four weeks, Monday to Thursday 9:30 AM to 4:30 PM. The 2027 program runs July 12 to Aug 5, 2027. No housing, meals or college credit.
deadline_text: Registration and scholarship applications will open soon; no opening date is posted. Scholarship applications are due Apr 11, 2027. Open enrollment is due Jul 5, 2027. Join the mailing list on the page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the registration form and pay tuition to enroll. The page also links a scholarship section for the Jeffery and Paul Gural Merit Scholarship for NYC Public School Students. Questions: the program email is on the page.
notes: This is a commuter program on campus. The page does not give housing or college credit.
